caption:
The AI notetaker quietly beating Otter in almost every review — and barely anyone's talking about it.

Fathom joins your Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams call, records it, and has a written summary ready the second the call ends. That's the easy part. The strange-in-a-good-way part: every line of that summary is timestamped. Click a single sentence and it jumps straight back into the recording and replays that exact moment. No more trying to remember what someone actually said three days later.

It also holds a conversation about your own meeting history. Ask it "what did we agree on pricing last month?" and it answers from the real transcript, not a guess.

It's not sneaky about being there — it shows up in the call as "Fathom Notetaker" so everyone can see it, and like any transcription tool it can slip a little on messy audio. That honesty is part of why it's built up over 6,000 reviews on G2 with a full 5.0 average, plus a string of independent comparisons against Otter and Fireflies.

And this isn't just a work-call tool. Job interviews, therapy or coaching sessions, a family Zoom with a lawyer or doctor — anywhere you'd rather be present than scribbling. The free tier is genuinely generous too, not a countdown clock, which is a big reason people actually stick with it.

Save this so you don't lose it. Full breakdown — link in bio.
